controller-help: Choose the Xbox button for each console button. Game menus may use different confirm and cancel buttons.
launch-help: Saved settings apply on the next launch from Aurora or any Sunshine client.
mapping-unavailable: Button remapping is not available for this emulator yet.
message-size-help: Applies to PCSX2 and RetroArch. The default TV size is 200%.
messages-help: Warnings remain here after the game closes. These are emulator messages, not a complete log.
not-configured: The Sunshine integration has not been configured on this server.
quit-help: Quit: hold left stick click + Menu for two seconds. This shortcut is separate from game mappings.
resolution-help: Changes game rendering, not the Sunshine stream resolution.
save-failed: Could not save. Reload the settings before trying again.
saved: Saved. Applies on the next game launch.
stale: The launcher has stopped reporting. Check Sunshine before changing settings.
title: RomM + Sunshine
unavailable: Integration data could not be loaded.
widescreen-help: Enable 16:9 only for a game with native widescreen or a compatible patch. Other games may stretch or show glitches.
